brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming Israel's next government, has invited Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party to join coalition negotiations, according to Middle East Eye. The move signals the opening of formal talks with Netanyahu's bloc as Eisenkot pursues a governing majority.

The invitation marks a critical stage in Israel's coalition-building process following elections. Eisenkot must secure enough parliamentary support to form a viable government, and Likud's participation would substantially influence the composition and policies of the emerging administration.

title: Eisenkot invites Netanyahu's Likud into Israeli coalition talks
